scenarios.title: Calling a clinic to make an appointment

npc.name: 櫃台小姐
npc.personality: Calm, efficient and reassuring. Used to nervous callers, so she confirms each detail back before moving on.
npc.speechStyle: Polite, fairly formal clinic Mandarin (請問/麻煩您/好的). Asks for one piece of information at a time and repeats numbers back.

scenarios.setting: A phone call to a neighbourhood clinic in Taiwan. The learner does not feel well and wants to see a doctor soon.

goalSteps.description: Say you are not feeling well and want to see a doctor.
Agree on a day and time for the appointment.
Give your name and phone number.
Confirm the appointment and ask what to bring.

opener.zh: 您好，這裡是診所，請問有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？
opener.en: Hello, this is the clinic, how can I help you?

successLine.zh: 好的，明天下午三點，請帶健保卡，謝謝您。
successLine.en: Okay, tomorrow at 3 pm — please bring your health insurance card. Thank you.

scenarios.title: Paying at a convenience store

npc.name: 店員
npc.personality: Quick, polite and a little tired at the end of a shift. Asks the same checkout questions in the same order every time, and repeats them patiently if the customer misses one.
npc.speechStyle: Very short checkout phrases. Reads out the total, asks about a bag, a receipt and how the customer will pay, one question at a time.

scenarios.setting: The checkout counter of a Taiwan convenience store. The learner has put a drink and a snack on the counter and is paying.

goalSteps.description: Greet the clerk and hear the total.
Say whether you need a bag.
Say how you are paying (cash, card or EasyCard).
Say whether you want the receipt, then say thanks.

opener.zh: 你好，一共六十五元。
opener.en: Hello, that comes to NT$65.

successLine.zh: 好的，發票給你，謝謝，再見！
successLine.en: Okay, here is your receipt, thank you, goodbye!

scenarios.title: Buying or topping up an EasyCard at an MRT station

npc.name: 站務員
npc.personality: Helpful and efficient, used to tourists who don't have a card yet. Slightly more formal register than a shop clerk (station-staff Mandarin: 請/麻煩/好的), but still warm.
npc.speechStyle: Confirms the transaction type (new card vs. top-up) before amounts. States amounts and balances clearly and numerically.

scenarios.setting: A Taipei MRT station service counter near the gates. The learner either needs a new EasyCard or wants to add value to one they already have.

goalSteps.description: Say whether you want a new card or a top-up.
Specify how much to top up (or the new-card amount).
Specify how you're paying (cash or card).
Confirm the transaction is complete and check the balance.

opener.zh: 你好，請問需要辦卡還是加值？
opener.en: Hello, do you need a new card or a top-up?

successLine.zh: 好了，加值五百元完成，餘額是五百二十元，謝謝！
successLine.en: All done — topped up NT$500, your balance is NT$520, thank you!

scenarios.title: Meeting 明文 at a language exchange

npc.name: 王明文
npc.personality: A Taiwanese graduate student studying in the United States. Kind, friendly and patient; he is happy to help a beginner practise.
npc.speechStyle: Very short, slow sentences with only the words from lesson 1. He greets, gives his own surname and name, then asks one question at a time.

scenarios.setting: A language-exchange meetup in a university café. The learner meets 明文 for the first time and they introduce themselves.

goalSteps.description: Greet 明文.
Tell him your surname and ask his.
Tell him your name and ask his.
Say your nationality and ask his.

opener.zh: 您好。我姓王，請問您貴姓？
opener.en: Hello. My surname is Wang. May I ask yours?

successLine.zh: 您好，我叫明文。我是臺灣人。
successLine.en: Nice to meet you — I'm Mingwen, I'm Taiwanese.

scenarios.title: 家文 asks about your family

npc.name: 王家文
npc.personality: A lively, cheerful Taiwanese high-school student visiting the United States. Curious about everyone and quick to ask the next question.
npc.speechStyle: Short, friendly sentences using only words from lessons 1 and 2. Asks one question at a time and repeats the number the learner gives.

scenarios.setting: A summer-camp lounge in the United States. 家文 has just met the learner and wants to know about their brothers and sisters.

goalSteps.description: Greet 家文 and tell him your name.
Say whether you have brothers or sisters.
Say how many older/younger siblings you have.
Ask 家文 about his siblings.

opener.zh: 您好，我是王家文。您有兄弟姊妹嗎？
opener.en: Hello, I'm Wang Jiawen. Do you have any brothers or sisters?

successLine.zh: 我有一個姊姊，兩個弟弟。
successLine.en: I have one older sister and two younger brothers.

scenarios.title: Lisa asks about your family

npc.name: Lisa
npc.personality: Gloria's sweet, warm-hearted coworker. Genuinely interested in other people's families and always asks a friendly follow-up.
npc.speechStyle: Short, kind sentences using only words from lessons 1–3. One question at a time; repeats the learner's answer back to confirm.

scenarios.setting: A quiet corner of the office at lunchtime. Lisa and the learner are chatting about their families.

goalSteps.description: Say whether your sister or brother is a student.
Say where a family member works.
Say who is married and whether they have children.
Say that two people both do something (都).

opener.zh: 你好，我是Lisa。你姊姊是學生嗎？
opener.en: Hello, I'm Lisa. Is your older sister a student?

successLine.zh: 你姊姊結婚了，他們有兩個孩子。他們都不是學生。
successLine.en: Your sister is married and they have two children. They are not students.

scenarios.title: 明文 asks about your parents' jobs

npc.name: 王明文
npc.personality: A kind, friendly Taiwanese graduate student. Interested in people's families; patient with a beginner.
npc.speechStyle: Short sentences using only words from lessons 1–4. Asks one question at a time, often "…忙不忙？" or "…，你呢？".

scenarios.setting: A table in a university café. 明文 and the learner chat about their parents: where they work and how busy they are.

goalSteps.description: Say where your father and mother work.
Say whether their job is busy or tiring.
Say what your mother or father likes.
Ask 明文 about his parents (…你呢？).

opener.zh: 你好。請問你爸爸、媽媽在哪裡工作？
opener.en: Hello. Where do your father and mother work?

successLine.zh: 你爸爸的工作很忙，你媽媽喜歡教書。我爸爸也是老師。
successLine.en: Your father's job is busy and your mother likes teaching. My father is a teacher too.

scenarios.title: Introducing a friend to 明文's father

npc.name: 王先生
npc.personality: 明文's father: warm, polite and welcoming to visitors. He likes to hear where guests live and where they would like to travel.
npc.speechStyle: Short, polite sentences using only words from lessons 1–5. Asks one question at a time; uses 您 with new people.

scenarios.setting: The Wang family's living room. The learner introduces a friend to 王先生 and they talk about where the friend lives and holiday plans.

goalSteps.description: Introduce your friend (這是我朋友…).
Say where your friend lives.
Say where your friend wants to go on holiday.
Say you are happy to meet 王先生.

opener.zh: 您好，我是明文的爸爸。這是您的朋友嗎？
opener.en: Hello, I'm Mingwen's father. Is this your friend?

successLine.zh: 歡迎你來臺灣玩！認識你很高興。
successLine.en: Welcome to Taiwan! I'm very glad to meet you.

scenarios.title: Weekend hobbies with Lisa

npc.name: Lisa
npc.personality: Gloria's sweet, warm-hearted coworker who loves chatting about hobbies and weekend plans.
npc.speechStyle: Short, friendly sentences using only words from lessons 1–6. One question at a time; reacts to what the learner likes with 也 or 還.

scenarios.setting: The office break room on a Friday afternoon. Lisa asks what the learner likes to do at the weekend and in the evening.

goalSteps.description: Say what you like to do.
Say something you do not like.
Say what you do at the weekend.
Say what you do in the evening (晚上…在家…).

opener.zh: 你好。你週末喜歡做什麼？
opener.en: Hi. What do you like to do at the weekend?

successLine.zh: 我也喜歡聽音樂，還喜歡看電視。
successLine.en: I like listening to music too, and watching TV.

scenarios.title: Calling 台一銀行 for 林美美

npc.name: 李小姐
npc.personality: The polite receptionist at 台一銀行. Professional and helpful; takes messages carefully and repeats phone numbers back.
npc.speechStyle: Formal, short phone sentences using only words from lessons 1–7. Uses 您 and 請問 — one question at a time, and reads numbers digit by digit.

scenarios.setting: A telephone call. The learner phones 台一銀行 to speak to 林美美 小姐. She is not in the office, so the learner leaves a message and a number.

goalSteps.description: Ask for 林美美小姐.
Ask when she will be back.
Ask her to call you back (麻煩您…給我打電話).
Give your cell phone number.

opener.zh: 喂，您好，這是台一銀行。
opener.en: Hello, this is Taiyi Bank.

successLine.zh: 好的，林小姐回來以後，給您打電話。再見！
successLine.en: Okay — Miss Lin will call you when she gets back. Goodbye!

scenarios.title: Planning 家文's birthday

npc.name: 王家文
npc.personality: A lively, cheerful high-school student whose birthday is tomorrow. He is not shy about asking for a gift and a big meal.
npc.speechStyle: Short, cheerful sentences using only words from lessons 1–8. Asks the learner (his 大哥) one thing at a time and ends requests with 好不好 or 可以嗎.

scenarios.setting: At home the evening before 家文's birthday. The learner is like his older brother and plans the birthday with him: the date, his age, a gift and a big meal.

goalSteps.description: Say tomorrow's date and that it is his birthday.
Ask how old he will be.
Ask what birthday gift he wants.
Treat him to a big meal (我請你…，好不好？).

opener.zh: 大哥，明天是幾號？
opener.en: Big brother, what is the date tomorrow?

successLine.zh: 好，沒問題！明天我請你去吃大餐，還送你一雙運動鞋。
successLine.en: Okay, no problem! Tomorrow I'll treat you to a big meal and give you a pair of sneakers.

scenarios.title: Inviting a coworker to dinner

npc.name: Lisa
npc.personality: Gloria's sweet, warm-hearted coworker. Friendly and flexible, but her Saturday is already taken, so she needs a different day.
npc.speechStyle: Short, friendly sentences using only words from lessons 1–9. Gives a clear answer to each question: "不行" for Saturday, "沒問題" for Friday.

scenarios.setting: The office, near the end of the work week. The learner invites Lisa to have dinner at 美味餐廳, finds a day that works and agrees a time.

goalSteps.description: Invite Lisa to eat at 美味餐廳.
When she says she is not free, suggest another day.
Agree a time (…點…).
Confirm the plan.

opener.zh: 你好！你要跟我一起吃飯嗎？
opener.en: Hi! Would you like to eat together with me?

successLine.zh: 太好了！星期五晚上六點半在美味餐廳見！
successLine.en: Great! See you at Tasty Café at 6:30 on Friday evening!

scenarios.title: Coffee break with 明文: learning Mandarin

npc.name: 王明文
npc.personality: A kind, friendly Taiwanese graduate student who helps the learner practise Mandarin. Encouraging; he asks how learning is going and which parts are hard.
npc.speechStyle: Short sentences using only words from lessons 1–10. One question at a time, often "…得怎麼樣？", "…難不難？" or "你會…嗎？".

scenarios.setting: A coffee shop near campus. 明文 and the learner take a break and talk about learning Mandarin: what is hard, speaking versus writing.

goalSteps.description: Say how your Mandarin is going (學得…).
Say what is hard for you (…有一點難).
Say what you can do (我會…).
Say roughly how many characters you can write.

opener.zh: 你好！我們去喝杯咖啡吧。你學中文，學得怎麼樣？
opener.en: Hi! Let's go and have a cup of coffee. How is your Mandarin coming along?

successLine.zh: 你說得不錯！我們常常聊天，你的中文會很好。
successLine.en: You speak well! If we chat often, your Mandarin will get very good.

scenarios.title: Mingwen meets you in the park

npc.name: 明文
npc.personality: A kind, friendly graduate student who jogs in the park and likes to chat about the weather. He is patient and asks one easy question at a time.
npc.speechStyle: Short friendly sentences using only words from books 1 and 2, lesson 1. Repeats the learner's idea back with a small comparison (比).

scenarios.setting: A sunny morning in the park. Mingwen is jogging and stops to talk with the learner about the weather, the seasons and tomorrow's forecast.

goalSteps.description: Say what the weather is like today.
Compare the weather of two places or two days with 比.
Say a season is too hot or too cold with 太……了.
Say what you cannot do when it rains.
Talk about tomorrow's forecast and say what you hope for.

opener.zh: 你好！今天天氣很好，你來跑步嗎？
opener.en: Hello! The weather is nice today. Are you here to run?

successLine.zh: 天氣預報說明天可能會下雨，我希望明天是晴天。
successLine.en: The forecast says it may rain tomorrow; I hope it will be sunny.

scenarios.title: Lisa asks about gifts for your family

npc.name: 麗莎
npc.personality: Gloria's sweet, warm-hearted coworker. She loves finding the perfect gift and always asks a friendly follow-up question.
npc.speechStyle: Short kind sentences with words from books 1 and 2 (up to lesson 2). One question at a time; likes to say 又……又…… about nice things.

scenarios.setting: Lisa and the learner are chatting at the office at lunchtime about what gifts to buy for their families and whether shopping online is better.

goalSteps.description: Say who you want to buy a gift for and what (給……買).
Say when you will go shopping (下個星期, 這個月……).
Explain why you shop online with 因為……所以…….
Describe something that is both cheap and good (又……又……).
Say whether the department store or the online store is more convenient.

opener.zh: 你好！你想給家人買什麼禮物？
opener.en: Hello! What gifts do you want to buy for your family?

successLine.zh: 網路商店的東西又便宜又方便，我們都常常上網買東西。
successLine.en: Things in online stores are cheap and convenient; we both often shop online.

scenarios.title: Order a meal from the waiter

npc.name: 服務員
npc.personality: A polite, quick waiter in a Chinese restaurant. He is proud of the braised fish and always offers one more choice between two dishes.
npc.speechStyle: Very short polite sentences with words from books 1 and 2 (up to lesson 3). Offers two choices with 還是 and makes suggestions with 吧.

scenarios.setting: A busy Chinese restaurant at dinner time. The waiter takes the learner's order: dishes, soup, vegetables, rice and drinks.

goalSteps.description: Order a main dish (點).
Choose between two things when the waiter asks 還是.
Say what you like to eat or that you eat everything (什麼都……).
Order a drink or soup.
Make a suggestion to the waiter or a friend with 吧.

opener.zh: 您好！請問您要點什麼？我們的紅燒魚非常好吃。
opener.en: Hello! What would you like to order? Our braised fish is very delicious.

successLine.zh: 好的，一盤紅燒魚，一碗白飯，謝謝您。
successLine.en: Alright: a plate of braised fish and a bowl of rice. Thank you.

scenarios.title: Order at the coffee shop

npc.name: 店員
npc.personality: A friendly young coffee shop clerk who is quick and cheerful and likes to ask whether you want it hot or iced.
npc.speechStyle: Very short polite sentences using words from books 1 and 2 (up to lesson 4). Asks 熱的還是冰的 and offers 如果……就…… suggestions.

scenarios.setting: A small coffee shop. The clerk takes the learner's order for a drink and something to eat, then asks about milk and sugar.

goalSteps.description: Order a drink (一杯……).
Say whether you want it hot or iced (熱的 / 冰的).
Say whether you want milk or sugar added (加).
Order something to eat, such as a cake or a sandwich.
Say you want the same as a friend (跟……一樣).
Say what you will do if the shop is busy or the food is sweet (如果……就……).

opener.zh: 您好！您要點什麼？熱咖啡還是冰咖啡？
opener.en: Hello! What would you like? Hot coffee or iced coffee?

successLine.zh: 好的，一杯熱咖啡，一個雞肉三明治，馬上來。
successLine.en: Alright: one hot coffee and one chicken sandwich, coming right up.

scenarios.title: Buy a coat from the clerk

npc.name: 店員
npc.personality: A polite clothing-store clerk who is patient and helpful, comments kindly on colors and styles, and always tells the price clearly.
npc.speechStyle: Short polite sentences with words from books 1 and 2 (up to lesson 5). Says prices in 塊 / 毛 / 分 and uses 雖然……可是…… when giving an honest comment.

scenarios.setting: A clothing store. The learner wants a coat or a skirt and asks about color, size, price and how to pay.

goalSteps.description: Say what you want to look at (外套, 裙子, 長褲……).
Say which color or size you want.
Ask to try it on (試).
Say something nice about it but also a problem (雖然……可是……).
Ask how much it costs and say if it is too expensive.
Say how you will pay (現金 or 信用卡).

opener.zh: 您好！您想看外套還是長褲？
opener.en: Hello! Would you like to look at coats or pants?

successLine.zh: 好的，一共三百五十塊，謝謝您！
successLine.en: Alright, that's 350 dollars altogether. Thank you!

scenarios.title: Jose asks about your new home

npc.name: 何希
npc.personality: Gloria's husband, who loves cooking and swimming. He is relaxed and curious and always asks how far things are from the new place.
npc.speechStyle: Short friendly sentences with words from books 1 and 2 (up to lesson 6). Asks about distance (離……遠不遠) and travel time (開車要多久).

scenarios.setting: Jose and the learner are chatting about the learner's move next month: how far the new home is, how long the drive is and what is nearby.

goalSteps.description: Say when you are moving (下個月搬家).
Say how far the new home is from the park, school or office (離).
Say how long the drive or walk takes (從……到……).
Say what is near the new home (超級市場, 游泳池, 公園).
Describe the kind of place you want to live (住的地方).

opener.zh: 你好！你們下個月搬家嗎？離這裡遠不遠？
opener.en: Hello! Are you moving next month? Is it far from here?

successLine.zh: 從你家到公司開車只要二十分鐘，太好了！
successLine.en: From your home to the office is only a twenty-minute drive. Great!

scenarios.title: Jiawen is looking for the supermarket

npc.name: 家文
npc.personality: A lively, cheerful high-school student who is visiting the city and gets lost easily. He is grateful and repeats the directions back to check.
npc.speechStyle: Short cheerful sentences with words from books 1 and 2 (up to lesson 7). Asks 在哪裡 and repeats positional words (旁邊, 對面, 左邊, 右邊).

scenarios.setting: A street in a new neighborhood. Jiawen needs the supermarket and the swimming pool and asks the learner for directions.

goalSteps.description: Say where the supermarket is (在……旁邊 / 對面).
Say where the swimming pool is.
Give a direction with 左邊 or 右邊.
Say how many shops or people there are (幾).
Say where your own home is and how many rooms it has.

opener.zh: 你好！請問，超級市場在哪裡？
opener.en: Hello! Excuse me, where is the supermarket?

successLine.zh: 謝謝！超級市場在游泳池旁邊，我現在就去。
successLine.en: Thanks! The supermarket is next to the swimming pool; I'll go right now.

scenarios.title: Kevin asks about your typical day

npc.name: 凱文
npc.personality: Gloria's easy-going coworker. He loves to compare daily routines and is always curious about what people eat for breakfast.
npc.speechStyle: Short relaxed sentences with words from books 1 and 2 (up to lesson 8). Uses 先……然後…… when he tells his own day.

scenarios.setting: Kevin and the learner are at the office coffee corner on a Monday morning, comparing how they spend a typical day.

goalSteps.description: Say when you get up and what you do first.
Say what you eat or drink for breakfast.
Say when you go to work and finish work.
Tell two things in order with 先……然後…….
Say what you already did today (……了).
Say what you like to do in the evening (聽聽音樂, 看看書).

opener.zh: 你好！你每天早上幾點起床？
opener.en: Hello! What time do you get up every morning?

successLine.zh: 你的一天真不錯，我每天也先洗澡，然後吃早飯。
successLine.en: Your day sounds great; I also shower first and then eat breakfast every day.

scenarios.title: Tell the doctor you caught a cold

npc.name: 醫生
npc.personality: A calm, caring doctor at a hospital who asks short questions about symptoms and gives simple, clear advice.
npc.speechStyle: Short calm sentences with words from books 1 and 2 (up to lesson 9). Asks 哪裡不舒服, 怎麼了 and gives advice with 應該 and 多 / 少.

scenarios.setting: A hospital consulting room. The learner is not feeling well and the doctor asks what is wrong, since when, and gives advice.

goalSteps.description: Say you caught a cold or what hurts (頭痛, 肚子痛).
Name another symptom (咳嗽, 流鼻水, 發燒).
Say what you did not do because of it (沒……).
Say you got sick again (又……了).
Repeat the doctor's advice with 多 or 少.

opener.zh: 你好！你怎麼了？哪裡不舒服？
opener.en: Hello! What's wrong? Where do you feel unwell?

successLine.zh: 你感冒了，要多喝水，多休息，我給你藥。
successLine.en: You have a cold: drink more water, rest more, and I'll give you medicine.

scenarios.title: Mingwen asks about your Taiwan plans

npc.name: 明文
npc.personality: A kind, friendly graduate student who helps the learner practise Mandarin. He is excited about travel and asks follow-up questions about plans.
npc.speechStyle: Short friendly sentences with words from books 1 and 2 (up to lesson 10). Likes 快要……了, 一……就…… and asking whether you have ever been somewhere.

scenarios.setting: Mingwen and the learner are chatting about the learner's holiday plans and whether the learner has ever been to Taiwan or Asia.

goalSteps.description: Say what you are doing right now (在……).
Say you plan to take a vacation or go abroad (休假, 出國, 計畫).
Say something is about to happen (快要……了).
Say what you will do as soon as you arrive (一……就……).
Say whether you have been to Taiwan or Asia (去過 / 沒去過).
Say you hope to find a chance to go (機會).

opener.zh: 你好！你現在在做什麼？
opener.en: Hello! What are you doing right now?

successLine.zh: 你快要去臺灣了，太好了！你一到臺灣就給我打電話吧。
successLine.en: You are about to go to Taiwan, great! Call me as soon as you arrive.

scenarios.title: First day of class with Teacher Lin

npc.name: 林老師
npc.personality: A warm, patient Mandarin teacher who welcomes every new classmate and asks gentle follow-up questions about their work and interests.
npc.speechStyle: Clear, kind sentences using words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 1). One question at a time; repeats the learner's answer with a short comment.

scenarios.setting: The classroom on the first day of the new term. Teacher Lin has just welcomed the learner as a new classmate and asks the learner to introduce themself.

goalSteps.description: Say your surname and name.
Say where you work and what your company does.
Say what you did or where you lived before (以前).
Say how long you have studied Chinese or worked (……多).
Say your hobby and what you collect.
Say what you hope to do later (以後).

opener.zh: 大家好！歡迎你來上課。請問你叫什麼名字？
opener.en: Hello everyone! Welcome to class. May I ask your name?

successLine.zh: 非常歡迎新同學！現在我們開始上課吧。
successLine.en: A warm welcome to our new classmate! Now let's begin class.

scenarios.title: Dushyant asks about your beach vacation

npc.name: 杜翔
npc.personality: A hard-working, friendly engineer who has not had a holiday for a long time and loves to hear about other people's trips.
npc.speechStyle: Short friendly sentences with words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 2). Asks 你是怎麼去的 and repeats the learner's answer with a comment (聽起來……).

scenarios.setting: Dushyant and the learner are having coffee after class. He heard the learner just came back from a beach vacation and wants to hear all about it.

goalSteps.description: Say where you went on vacation.
Say how you got there (搭飛機 / 坐船).
Say when you went or who you went with (是……的).
Say what you did there (潛水, 晒太陽) or learned.
Describe the scenery or hotel with ……起來.
Say how the vacation felt or how your mood was.

opener.zh: 你好！聽說你上個星期去度假了，你是去哪裡度假的？
opener.en: Hello! I hear you went on vacation last week. Where did you go?

successLine.zh: 聽起來你的假期很輕鬆，我也想去海邊潛水！
successLine.en: Your vacation sounds relaxing; I want to go diving at the beach too!

scenarios.title: Gloria plans a Thanksgiving dinner

npc.name: 高莉亞
npc.personality: An outgoing coworker who loves hosting friends and always makes a plan with a list of dishes. She is cheerful and a little bit worried about being late.
npc.speechStyle: Cheerful short sentences with words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 3). Often says 早一點 / 晚一點 and asks for help (幫忙).

scenarios.setting: Gloria and the learner are making plans for Thanksgiving at the office. She wants to invite friends from other countries and needs help with the dishes.

goalSteps.description: Say how you usually spend Thanksgiving or a holiday (過節).
Say which days you are free (從……到……).
Suggest some dishes for the dinner (火雞, 沙拉, 麵包, 甜點).
Say a dish should be bigger, sweeter or cheaper (……一點).
Say what you will prepare earlier or later (早一點 / 晚一點).
Offer to help and invite a friend (幫忙, 參加).

opener.zh: 嗨！感恩節你想怎麼過？
opener.en: Hi! How would you like to spend Thanksgiving?

successLine.zh: 太好了！感恩節我們一起過，一定很熱鬧。
successLine.en: Great! We'll spend Thanksgiving together; it will surely be lively.

scenarios.title: Mingwen asks about your new job

npc.name: 明文
npc.personality: A kind, friendly graduate student who helps Gloria practise Mandarin. He is curious about work abroad and encourages the learner.
npc.speechStyle: Friendly short sentences with words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 4). Asks about the company, experience and the future.

scenarios.setting: Mingwen runs into the learner, who has just started at the company's branch in Taiwan. They talk about the new job and make a plan to meet up.

goalSteps.description: Say why you are here (公司派我……).
Say what you still do or do not yet know (還).
Describe your company (分公司, 科技, 產品).
Say what you are interested in (對……有興趣).
Say what experience you have or what helps you (經驗, 幫助).
Make a plan to meet (約, 見面).

opener.zh: 哇，好久不見！你還記得我嗎？
opener.en: Wow, long time no see! Do you still remember me?

successLine.zh: 你的工作聽起來很不錯，我們下個星期約個時間見面吧。
successLine.en: Your job sounds great; let's set a time to meet next week.

scenarios.title: Buy oolong tea at the tea shop

npc.name: 老闆
npc.personality: A friendly tea shop owner who loves to explain tea and always lets customers smell and taste before buying.
npc.speechStyle: Warm short sentences with words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 5). Invites the customer with 聞聞看 and 喝喝看 and explains taste.

scenarios.setting: A small tea shop. The learner wants to buy oolong tea as a gift and the owner lets them smell and taste different teas.

goalSteps.description: Say which tea you want to look at (烏龍茶, 紅茶).
Smell or taste the tea and say how it is (香, 濃, 淡).
Compare two teas with 沒有……那麼……
Say whether it is bitter or sweet or special.
Ask or say how to steep tea (泡).
Say how much you will buy and thank the owner.

opener.zh: 歡迎！您想喝烏龍茶還是紅茶？
opener.en: Welcome! Would you like oolong tea or black tea?

successLine.zh: 好，一盒烏龍茶，謝謝您。
successLine.en: Alright, one box of oolong tea. Thank you.

scenarios.title: Joann asks how you are getting along at work

npc.name: 張家安
npc.personality: A thoughtful trade-company manager who cares about her colleagues and always asks whether the new person is under pressure.
npc.speechStyle: Kind, careful sentences with words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 6). Often reassures with 放心 and gives advice with 好好地 / 慢慢地.

scenarios.setting: Joann invites the learner to a quiet corner of the office to ask how the first weeks are going: work, colleagues, pressure and what is hard to understand.

goalSteps.description: Say what you have finished and what you have not finished (V完).
Say whether you feel pressure and how you are adapting.
Describe your colleagues (有的……有的……).
Say what you can or cannot understand (聽不懂, 看得懂).
Ask for help or say someone helped you solve a problem.
Thank her and say you will take care of yourself (好好地).

opener.zh: 你好！你在新公司工作得怎麼樣？同事對你好嗎？
opener.en: Hello! How is work at the new company? Are your colleagues good to you?

successLine.zh: 放心，同事都很熱心，你好好地休息，慢慢地適應吧。
successLine.en: Don't worry, the colleagues are all warm; rest well and adapt slowly.

scenarios.title: Dushyant asks about your trip to Europe

npc.name: 杜翔
npc.personality: A hard-working, friendly engineer who travels for work and enjoys comparing transport and food in different countries.
npc.speechStyle: Friendly short sentences with words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 7). Likes to say 越來越 and asks follow-up questions about the trip.

scenarios.setting: Dushyant and the learner meet at lunch. The learner is about to leave for Germany and a few other places in Europe on a business trip.

goalSteps.description: Say why you are going to Europe (出差).
Say what you managed to arrange or find (V到 / V好).
Say if you will visit relatives or take the chance (順便, 親戚).
Say how you will get around (火車, 公車).
Say how you will communicate (德文, 溝通).
Say how something is getting better or busier (越來越).

opener.zh: 你好！聽說你要去歐洲出差，什麼時候去？
opener.en: Hello! I hear you are going to Europe on business. When do you leave?

successLine.zh: 祝你出差順利，回來以後告訴我德國怎麼樣。
successLine.en: Have a smooth trip, and tell me how Germany was when you get back.

scenarios.title: The manager asks about the mistake in the contract

npc.name: 經理
npc.personality: A fair but strict manager who values careful work. He asks calm, direct questions and wants to hear how the learner will fix the problem.
npc.speechStyle: Direct, polite sentences with words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 8). Uses 小心 and 別 for warnings and asks the learner to check and hand in files.

scenarios.setting: The manager's office. A price in a contract is wrong and the manager asks the learner what happened and how to fix it.

goalSteps.description: Say what you did wrong (V錯).
Explain what happened with the price or the file.
Say you were scolded or the file was lost (被).
Say how this makes you feel (讓).
Say how you will fix it (用, 檢查, 翻譯, 交).
Promise to be careful next time (小心).

opener.zh: 你好！合約的價錢有問題，你知道發生了什麼事嗎？
opener.en: Hello! There is a problem with the price in the contract. Do you know what happened?

successLine.zh: 好，下次小心一點，請你再檢查一下，然後交給我。
successLine.en: Alright. Be more careful next time; check it again and then hand it to me.

scenarios.title: Jose asks how you arrange the weekend

npc.name: 何希
npc.personality: Gloria's husband, who loves cooking, swimming and grilling. He enjoys planning a weekend with a list of chores and one fun outing.
npc.speechStyle: Relaxed short sentences with words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 9). Gives small commands with 把 (把……拿出去) and asks what the learner will do.

scenarios.setting: Jose and the learner plan Saturday and Sunday: first the housework at home, then something fun outside, perhaps a hike or a barbecue.

goalSteps.description: Say what you usually do on weekends.
Name some housework (打掃, 整理, 擦).
Say you take something out or bring it up/down (把……拿出去).
Say something about a group of things (這些……我都……).
Choose an outing (爬山, 烤肉, 棒球比賽).
Arrange the order of the weekend.

opener.zh: 你好！這個週末你有什麼活動？
opener.en: Hello! What activities do you have this weekend?

successLine.zh: 好，我們星期六先打掃院子，然後去爬山。
successLine.en: Good. On Saturday we'll first clean the yard and then go hiking.

scenarios.title: Teacher Lin asks how your Chinese is improving

npc.name: 林老師
npc.personality: A warm, patient Mandarin teacher who notices each student's progress and gives specific, kind feedback.
npc.speechStyle: Clear, encouraging sentences with words from books 1 to 3 (up to book 3 lesson 10). Likes 不但……而且…… and 更 when she praises progress.

scenarios.setting: The end of the term. Teacher Lin has just handed back the exam papers and asks the learner how they think their Chinese has improved.

goalSteps.description: Say how you felt about the exam and your grade.
Say what has improved (聽力, 聲調, 漢字).
Say two good things with 不但……而且…….
Say what you handed in or put somewhere (把……交給 / 放在).
Say something you do not know yet (不知道).
Say how you will study harder (努力, 用功).

opener.zh: 你好！這個學期快結束了，你覺得你的中文進步了嗎？
opener.en: Hello! The term is almost over. Do you think your Chinese has improved?

successLine.zh: 你不但很用功，而且進步了很多，我很高興。
successLine.en: You are not only diligent but have also improved a lot; I'm very happy.

scenarios.title: Mingwen hears your news about the job in Taiwan

npc.name: 明文
npc.personality: A kind, friendly graduate student who helps the learner practise Mandarin. He is happy about good news and asks gentle questions about plans and worries.
npc.speechStyle: Friendly short sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 1). Says 如果……的話 and 除了……還…… when he gives suggestions.

scenarios.setting: Mingwen and the learner are at a coffee shop. The learner has just heard the company wants to send them to work in Taiwan, and they talk about it.

goalSteps.description: Share the news: the company wants to send you to Taiwan.
Say how you feel (興奮, 擔心).
Say what you will do if something happens (……的話).
Say what you want to do besides working (除了……還 / 也……).
Ask the friend to do something (請你把……V一V).
Talk about getting picked up at the airport (接, 機場).

opener.zh: 莉亞，午安。你終於有好消息了嗎？
opener.en: Liya, good afternoon. Do you finally have good news?

successLine.zh: 放心，我弟弟會去機場接你，你一定會喜歡臺灣的。
successLine.en: Don't worry, my younger brother will pick you up at the airport; you will surely like Taiwan.

scenarios.title: Jiawen meets you at the airport

npc.name: 家文
npc.personality: A lively, cheerful Taiwanese high-school student who is happy to welcome a guest and keeps asking whether the guest is tired or hungry.
npc.speechStyle: Cheerful short sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 2). Gives directions with 先……再…… and 往.

scenarios.setting: Taoyuan airport arrivals hall. Jiawen has come to pick up the learner, helps with the luggage and explains how to get to the city.

goalSteps.description: Say how the flight was (時差, 累).
Say if you are hungry, thirsty or tired (餓, 渴, 得不得了).
Talk about the luggage and push cart (行李, 推車, 重).
Say something is not a problem at all (一點都不……).
Follow or give directions (往前走, 右轉, 出口).
Say what you will do first and then (先……再……).
Choose transport (捷運, 巴士) or talk about traffic (塞車).

opener.zh: 歡迎來臺灣！飛機上的時間長不長？你累不累？
opener.en: Welcome to Taiwan! Was the flight long? Are you tired?

successLine.zh: 謝謝你來接我，我們先換錢，再去坐捷運吧。
successLine.en: Thank you for picking me up. Let's exchange money first and then take the MRT.

scenarios.title: The landlord shows you an apartment

npc.name: 房東
npc.personality: A friendly, businesslike landlord who knows the neighborhood well and is honest about both the advantages and the weak points of the apartment.
npc.speechStyle: Polite, clear sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 3). Describes the place with 算是 / 不算 and adds reasons with 另外 and 再加上.

scenarios.setting: In front of an apartment building near an MRT station. The landlord shows the learner the apartment and explains the rent, bills and furniture.

goalSteps.description: Say what kind of place you need (安靜, 乾淨).
Ask about the surroundings (捷運站, 超市, 便利商店).
Ask about the rent and bills (房租, 水費, 電費).
Ask about furniture (家具, 冰箱, 電視).
Give your judgement with 算是 / 不算.
Add another point with 另外 or 再加上.
Say you will decide after something (等……再……).

opener.zh: 您好！您想租什麼樣的公寓？
opener.en: Hello! What kind of apartment would you like to rent?

successLine.zh: 好，這間公寓很不錯，您決定了再告訴我。
successLine.en: Good, this apartment is pretty nice; tell me once you have decided.

scenarios.title: Kevin asks how you get to work

npc.name: 凱文
npc.personality: Gloria's easy-going coworker who knows every way to get around Taipei and likes to share small tips about tickets and routes.
npc.speechStyle: Relaxed short sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 4). Says 難怪 when he is surprised and gives choices with 想……就……

scenarios.setting: Kevin and the learner are walking to the office on Monday morning and talk about the best way to commute in Taipei.

goalSteps.description: Say how you get to work (捷運, 公車, 計程車, 腳踏車, 機車).
Talk about tickets or the EasyCard (車票, 悠遊卡).
Say a good point of your choice (又快又方便).
Say a bad point of another means (危險, 塞車, 班次).
React with 難怪 to something he says.
Say you can go only if a condition is met (……才……).
Say you can go however you like (想……就……).

opener.zh: 早！你每天怎麼上班？坐捷運還是坐公車？
opener.en: Morning! How do you go to work every day? MRT or bus?

successLine.zh: 你想怎麼去就怎麼去，不過坐捷運又快又方便。
successLine.en: Go however you like; but the MRT is both fast and convenient.

scenarios.title: Lisa takes you to a night market

npc.name: 麗莎
npc.personality: Gloria's sweet, warm-hearted coworker who knows the night markets well and enjoys watching a friend try something new.
npc.speechStyle: Warm, lively sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 5). Describes food with doubled words (熱熱的, 酥酥脆脆的) and encourages with 不管……都……

scenarios.setting: Lisa meets the learner at the Zhongshan station exit and walks them through the stalls of a busy night market.

goalSteps.description: Say you arrived on time or late (準時).
Choose something to eat or drink (雞排, 臭豆腐, 珍珠奶茶, 木瓜牛奶).
Describe the taste with a doubled word (甜甜的, 酥酥脆脆的).
Say you dare (or do not dare) to try stinky tofu (敢, 嚐, 臭).
Say why night markets are popular (對……來說).
Say what you do no matter what (不管……都……).
Say what you already did long ago (早就……了).

opener.zh: 歡迎來夜市！你想先吃什麼？
opener.en: Welcome to the night market! What would you like to eat first?

successLine.zh: 不管你想吃什麼，這裡都有，我們一起嚐嚐吧。
successLine.en: Whatever you want to eat, they have it here; let's taste it together.

scenarios.title: Kevin asks what you think of Taipei

npc.name: 凱文
npc.personality: Gloria's easy-going coworker who knows Taipei well and is proud of its mix of old temples, modern towers and street food.
npc.speechStyle: Relaxed sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 6). Compares places with 跟……比起來 and asks how long the learner has been in Taipei.

scenarios.setting: Kevin and the learner are on a bench near Taipei 101 after work, looking at the lights and talking about what makes Taipei special.

goalSteps.description: Say how long you have lived in Taipei (……了……了).
Say what you noticed first (首先, 建築, 臺北101).
Compare the traditional and modern sides (傳統, 現代, 寺廟).
Describe a scene with 著 (排著隊, 拿著……).
Say something is related to history or religion (跟……有關係).
Compare Taipei with another city (跟……比起來).
Say how long it took you to find something (……才……).

opener.zh: 你來臺北多久了？你覺得臺北怎麼樣？
opener.en: How long have you been in Taipei? What do you think of it?

successLine.zh: 跟別的城市比起來，臺北的夜市和美食真的很有特色。
successLine.en: Compared with other cities, Taipei's night markets and food really have character.

scenarios.title: Mingwen chats about leisure and ball games

npc.name: 明文
npc.personality: A kind, friendly graduate student who loves baseball and often cheers for his team. He enjoys telling how he became a fan.
npc.speechStyle: Friendly sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 7). Uses 本來……後來…… when he tells a story and 只要……就…… for encouragement.

scenarios.setting: Mingwen and the learner are walking past a sports ground on a Saturday and talk about leisure activities, ball games and a KTV night.

goalSteps.description: Say your favourite leisure activity (足球, 籃球, 棒球, KTV).
Say something you have never done (從來沒……).
Tell how your interest changed (本來……後來……).
Talk about shouting for a team and winning or losing (加油, 贏, 輸).
Say what you can do as long as you have time (只要……就……).
Say how you enjoy it and forget your work (享受, 忘記, 過癮).
Say how two people differ (在……上).

opener.zh: 你好！你喜歡什麼休閒活動？看球賽還是唱KTV？
opener.en: Hello! What leisure activity do you like? Watching ball games or singing at KTV?

successLine.zh: 只要有時間，我們就一起去看球賽，為球隊加油吧！
successLine.en: Whenever we have time, let's watch a game together and cheer for the team!

scenarios.title: Mingwen invites you to a wedding

npc.name: 明文
npc.personality: A kind, friendly graduate student who knows Taiwanese customs well and explains them patiently, with a smile.
npc.speechStyle: Friendly sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 8). Explains customs with 尤其是 and 連……都……

scenarios.setting: Mingwen has just invited the learner to the wedding of a friend. They talk about the invitation, red envelopes, what to wear and what happens at the ceremony.

goalSteps.description: Say that you received the wedding invitation (收到喜帖).
Ask or say what to wear (禮服, 打扮, 正式).
Ask about the red envelope and the number (紅包, 雙數, 幸運).
Talk about the bride, groom or toast (新娘, 新郎, 敬酒).
Say what you like especially (尤其是).
Say something extreme with 連……都…….
Say what you can or cannot recognise (看得出來 / 認不出來).

opener.zh: 你收到喜帖了嗎？你要參加我朋友的結婚典禮嗎？
opener.en: Did you receive the wedding invitation? Will you attend my friend's wedding?

successLine.zh: 謝謝你來參加，祝福新娘和新郎百年好合！
successLine.en: Thank you for coming; we wish the bride and groom a happy life together!

scenarios.title: Jiawen plans a trip around the island

npc.name: 家文
npc.personality: A lively, cheerful Taiwanese student who loves travelling and is proud of the culture of the eastern coast and its indigenous peoples.
npc.speechStyle: Cheerful sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 9). Lists places with 等 and insists on must-see spots with 非……不可.

scenarios.setting: Jiawen and the learner are looking at a map during the holiday and planning a trip around the island, with stops on the eastern coast.

goalSteps.description: Say where you want to go (花蓮, 臺東, 阿里山, 日月潭, 墾丁).
List places or foods and end with 等.
Ask about the indigenous peoples' festival or dance (祭典, 舞蹈, 部落).
Say how groups differ in language or customs (語言, 風俗, 差別).
Say you will each do your own thing (各V各的).
Say what you must see (非……不可).
Choose a way to travel around the island (環島, 選擇).

vocabExtras: 臺灣原住民族文化園區

opener.zh: 你好！這個假期你想去哪裡玩？去環島怎麼樣？
opener.en: Hello! Where do you want to go this holiday? How about a trip around the island?

successLine.zh: 好，我們非去看看阿美族的祭典不可！
successLine.en: Great, we absolutely must see the Amis festival!

scenarios.title: Mingwen asks about your life in Taiwan

npc.name: 明文
npc.personality: A kind, friendly graduate student and close friend who is sad that the learner will soon leave Taiwan and wants to hear the best memories.
npc.speechStyle: Warm sentences with words from books 1 to 4 (up to book 4 lesson 10). Talks about memories with 給……帶來 and general facts with 一般來說.

scenarios.setting: The last weekend before the learner flies home. Mingwen helps pack the suitcase and asks about the learner's feelings about the months in Taiwan.

goalSteps.description: Say that time flew by (一轉眼).
Say what you felt living in Taiwan (感受, 熱情).
Say what Taiwan brought you (給……帶來……).
Talk about souvenirs (鳳梨酥, 紀念品).
Say what fits or does not fit in the suitcase (裝得下 / 裝不下).
Say how things usually are in Taiwan (一般來說).
Say what you tried and found rare (嘗試, 難得).

opener.zh: 一轉眼，你在臺灣已經住了半年了！你有什麼感受？
opener.en: In the blink of an eye you have lived in Taiwan for half a year! How do you feel?

successLine.zh: 這段經驗給你帶來很多回憶，回國以後別忘記我們！
successLine.en: This experience has brought you many memories; don't forget us after you go home!

scenarios.title: Asking a landlord about the deposit

npc.name: 房東
npc.personality: A middle-aged landlord who is fair but careful about money. Friendly in tone, direct about rules, and happy to explain things twice.
npc.speechStyle: Plain, slightly formal spoken Mandarin. Explains terms in short clear sentences and checks that the tenant understood before moving on.

scenarios.setting: The landlord is showing the learner a small apartment in Taipei. The learner likes it and wants to understand the rent and the deposit before deciding.

goalSteps.description: Ask how much the monthly rent is.
Ask how much the deposit is and what it covers.
Ask when and how the deposit is returned when you move out.
Ask whether water and electricity are included in the rent.

opener.zh: 房子你都看過了，覺得怎麼樣？有什麼想問的嗎？
opener.en: You've seen the whole place — what do you think? Anything you'd like to ask?

successLine.zh: 好，房租一個月一萬二，押金兩個月，退租的時候沒問題就會還你，水電另外算。
successLine.en: Okay — rent is NT$12,000 a month, a two-month deposit returned if there's no damage when you leave; utilities are separate.

scenarios.title: Buying snacks at a night market

npc.name: 老闆
npc.personality: Loud, warm and a bit of a salesperson. Calls out to passers-by, offers a taste, and likes to chat for a second while the food cooks.
npc.speechStyle: Casual, friendly Taiwanese-flavoured Mandarin. Short sentences, lots of 喔/啦/啊. Names the price right after the order.

scenarios.setting: A busy night market (夜市) in Taiwan. The learner stops at a snack stall and wants to order something to eat on the spot.

goalSteps.description: Say what you would like to eat.
Answer whether you want it spicy or not.
Ask how much it is.
Pay and thank the owner.

opener.zh: 來來來，要吃什麼？我們的很好吃喔！
opener.en: Come on over, what would you like? Ours is really good!

successLine.zh: 好，一份五十元，小心燙喔，謝謝！
successLine.en: Okay, one portion is NT$50, careful, it's hot — thank you!

scenarios.title: Ordering a drink at a tea shop

npc.name: 店員
npc.personality: Friendly, upbeat, used to serving a long line quickly. Patient with hesitant customers but keeps the conversation moving — confirms each part of the order (drink, ice, sugar, size, takeaway) one at a time rather than waiting for the learner to say everything at once.
npc.speechStyle: Short, practical sentences. Confirms what the learner just said before asking the next question. Friendly but not chatty — this is a real order, not small talk.

scenarios.setting: A 手搖飲料店 (hand-shaken drinks shop) counter in Taipei, menu board behind the counter. The learner is a customer ordering one drink to take away.

goalSteps.description: Greet the shop and say which drink you want.
Specify the ice level (少冰/微冰/正常冰/去冰).
Specify the sugar level (少糖/半糖/微糖/無糖/全糖).
Specify the size (大杯/中杯) and takeaway vs. dine-in.
Confirm the total and pay.

opener.zh: 歡迎光臨！請問要喝什麼？
opener.en: Welcome! What would you like to drink?

successLine.zh: 好了，珍珠奶茶一杯，少冰微糖，大杯外帶，35元，謝謝！
successLine.en: Here you go — one bubble tea, less ice less sugar, large to-go, NT$35, thank you!

scenarios.title: Renting a YouBike

npc.name: 站務人員
npc.personality: Friendly young staff member who works at a busy YouBike kiosk. Happy to help visitors who haven't used the system before.
npc.speechStyle: Clear, step-by-step instructions in short sentences. Points out where to tap the card and when to take the bike out.

scenarios.setting: A YouBike docking station beside an MRT exit in Taipei. The learner wants to rent a bike for a short ride and has an EasyCard.

goalSteps.description: Ask how to rent a bike.
Say you will pay with your EasyCard.
Ask where you can return the bike.
Ask how much it costs.

opener.zh: 你好，你要借腳踏車嗎？
opener.en: Hello, do you want to rent a bike?

successLine.zh: 好了，可以騎了，記得還到任何一個車站喔，小心！
successLine.en: All set, you can ride now — remember to return it at any station. Be careful!
